contents.bytes: At least 3 people killed and 7 missing due to a 7.6 meter tsunami caused by rockslides falling into a narrow fjord near Puerto Aisen. Felt (VII) at Puerto Aisen and Puerto Chacabuco, (VI) at Coihaique, (V) at Balmaceda and (IV) at Cochrane.
